messages:
Ravi: FYI I'm opening a PR to rework the concurrency/playbook examples for Go + JS. Goal: make it clear how streaming + batching + KV-prefetch interact when using quant profiles (we keep seeing confusion in support tickets). Draft here: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/8423 :link:
Kat: Nice. Can you call out the expected latency vs throughput tradeoffs for the two quant profiles? people need concrete knobs. :eyes:
Ravi: Yes — planning a small table and a short decision flow (low-latency vs cost-optimized). Also adding an explicit example showing when to disable batching for streaming endpoints.
Eva: For the Go example can we include the minimal server-side code that demonstrates turning on continuous batching + KV prefetch? newbies ask for copy-paste.
Ravi: Good idea. Draft snippet I'm planning:
```go
// enable continuous batching + kv prefetch (pseudo)
client := redwood.NewClient(opts)
client.SetBatching(redwood.Batching{Enabled: true, MaxBatchMs: 8})
client.SetKVPrefetch(true)
resp, _ := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, req)
```
Kat: Looks good. For JS we should show both `await stream()` and an example using `onToken` callback so async consumers understand the difference.
Sam: Small ask — please add a note that certain quant profiles (e.g., balanced-thruput) will increase memory and therefore may reduce effective batch size on small GPUs. We had a case where users hit OOM with 8-way batches.
Mino: Also include a short troubleshooting checklist: how to verify batching is active (console logs / metrics), how to detect KV prefetch misses, and recommended fallback (disable batching / switch quant profile).
Ravi: Agree. I'll add: - how to read `redwood.batch_size` metric - a sample `curl` to check streaming header
Ravi: Sample `curl` I plan to include:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=rwd-3"
```
Eva: Can docs-bot run the link-checker once the PR is up? last time a js sample linked to an internal api that moved.
docs-bot: @Ravi PR link-check scheduled. Running link-checker and snippet-linter on merge.
Kat: One more stylistic nit — avoid the term "disable batching" alone; prefer "set MaxBatchMs=0 or Batching.Enabled=false" so readers know the config keys.
Ravi: Good call. I'll update wording and ping for review. ETA EOD PT.
Sam: I'll do a quick perf sanity pass on my local 16GB test rig once PR is up (run the quick benchmark script).
Mino: If you want I can add a tiny end-to-end test in examples/ci that asserts streaming tokens arrive even with MaxBatchMs=0.
Ravi: Please do. Thanks everyone — will ping when ready for review. :thumbsup:
